description: テスト設計の中間成果物としてよく使われる3記法(リスト=FV表 / ダイアグラム=NGT / マトリクス=ゆもつよマトリクス)を受け取り、記法ごとの描画と決定的検査を1回の呼び出しで行う。各記法について宣言(記法上のラベル・網羅率宣言・記法間の対応宣言)と実体(行・ノード・セル・テスト条件ID母集団)を双方向に照合し、機能被覆率・葉ノード数・充填率は分母を明示して実測と突き合わせる。母集団が未宣言のときは率を算出せず、宣言値を裏付け不能として報告する。NGTの葉↔FV表の行↔マトリクスの行列という記法をまたいだ対応の欠落まで検出する。判定区分と対処指針は testdesign://notation/catalog を参照する。未投入の記法については生成指示のみを返す。

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

documents.description: Test basis documents used to substantiate FV table verification statements

fvTable.description: FV table (list notation); when omitted the tool returns generation instructions only

claimedFunctionCoveragePercent.description: Function coverage rate already claimed in the deliverable, cross-checked against the computed value

expectedFunctionIds.description: Full feature id population; without it the function coverage rate cannot be computed (TDN-07)

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from documents substantiating this row; falls back to verification when omitted

functionId.description: Feature id this row targets, matched against expectedFunctionIds

functionName.description: Function under test (the F of FV)

id.description: FV table row id; defaults to the 'FV-' + sequence number convention

ngtNodeId.description: NGT node id this row corresponds to; cross-checked as TDN-23

requirementIds.description: Requirement ids / sections this row derives from

testConditionIds.description: Test condition ids this row flows down into

verification.description: What is verified about that function (the V of FV)

idPatterns.description: Extra regular expression sources for requirement/feature IDs, added to the default pattern. Capture group count decides how the ID is built: 1 group = group 1 is used as the whole ID as-is (no hyphen joining), 2 groups = reconstructed as `${group1}-${group2}` (default pattern behavior), 0 groups = the whole match is used. Use a 1-group pattern for numeric-only IDs (031), dot-separated IDs (3.1.2) and underscore IDs (REQ_001) so the reported ID matches the notation in the source document. If a given pattern matches nothing, a [high] finding is emitted in the input digest.

ngt.description: NGT (diagram notation); when omitted the tool returns generation instructions only

claimedLeafCount.description: Leaf node count already claimed in the deliverable, cross-checked against the computed value

nodes.description: NGT nodes forming the perspective hierarchy

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from documents substantiating this node

id.description: NGT node id; defaults to the 'NG-' + sequence number convention

parentId.description: Parent node id; omit for the root node

perspectiveCategoryId.description: Test perspective catalog id (TPC-xx or TPC-xx-xx), cross-checked as TDN-15

testConditionIds.description: Test condition ids this node flows down into

relations.description: Non-hierarchical relations between nodes; parent-child pairs restated here are flagged as TDN-14

testConditionIds.description: Full test condition id population shared by the three notations, cross-checked in both directions

yumotsuyoMatrix.description: Yumotsuyo matrix (matrix notation); when omitted the tool returns generation instructions only

testConditionIds.description: Test conditions executed at this intersection; a cell without them counts as empty

claimedFillRatePercent.description: Fill rate already claimed in the deliverable, cross-checked against the computed value

ngtNodeId.description: NGT node id this column corresponds to; cross-checked as TDN-24

exclusions.description: Intersections intentionally left empty; excluded cells are removed from the fill rate denominator

reason.description: Why this intersection is intentionally not executed; omitting it is flagged as TDN-20

ngtNodeId.description: NGT node id this row corresponds to; cross-checked as TDN-24
